name: validature
description: Send documents for electronic signature, create and share reusable templates, follow signers and download signed files. Continue encrypted Vault workflows in Validature’s secure browser.

interface.longDescription: Send your own documents or a reusable template for signature, manage template access, follow requests, send reminders and retrieve signed documents. Vault content stays encrypted: continue sensitive workflows in the secure Validature browser.
defaultPrompt: Send this document for signature with Validature.
Create a reusable Validature template from this document.
Share my Validature template with a colleague.
Help me send a confidential document with Validature Vault.
